xbrli:xbrl.in-bse-shp:DisclosureOfNotesOnShareholdi: During the quarter ended June 30, 2026, TCI Trading (Dharmpal Agarwal), forming part of the Promoter Group, disposed of equity shares and TCI Express Consolidated Limited, also forming part of the Promoter Group, acquired equity shares through an inter se transfer within the Promoter Group executed through the open market on June 29 and June 30, 2026. Out of the total 1,23,900 equity shares transferred, the effect of 28,900 equity shares has been reflected in the Shareholding Pattern for the quarter ended June 30, 2026. However, the effect of the remaining 95,000 equity shares could not be reflected in the said Shareholding Pattern due to the timing of settlement/beneficial position as on the quarter end. Accordingly, the effect of these 95,000 equity shares shall be reflected in the Shareholding Pattern for the subsequent quarter.
